proof_body:
by
  intro F _ _ _ K u hne hc hconv
  have bdd : BddBelow (Set.range fun w : K => ‖u - (w : F)‖) :=
    ⟨0, by rintro _ ⟨w, rfl⟩; exact norm_nonneg _⟩
  haveI : Nonempty K := hne.to_subtype
  have min_iff : ∀ v ∈ K, (∀ w ∈ K, ‖u - v‖ ≤ ‖u - w‖) → ‖u - v‖ = ⨅ w : K, ‖u - (w : F)‖ :=
    fun v hv h => le_antisymm (le_ciInf fun w => h w w.2) (ciInf_le bdd ⟨v, hv⟩)
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hv'⟩ := exists_norm_eq_iInf_of_complete_convex hne hc.isComplete hconv u
  refine ⟨v, ⟨hv, fun w hw => hv' ▸ ciInf_le bdd ⟨w, hw⟩⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro v2 ⟨hv2, hmin⟩
  have h1 := (norm_eq_iInf_iff_real_inner_le_zero hconv hv).1 hv' v2 hv2
  have h2 := (norm_eq_iInf_iff_real_inner_le_zero hconv hv2).1 (min_iff v2 hv2 hmin) v hv
  have h3 : inner ℝ (v2 - v) (v2 - v) = inner ℝ (u - v) (v2 - v) + inner ℝ (u - v2) (v - v2) := by
    rw [show v - v2 = -(v2 - v) by abel, inner_neg_right, ← sub_eq_add_neg, ← inner_sub_left]
    congr 1
    abel
  have h4 : inner ℝ (v2 - v) (v2 - v) ≤ 0 := by linarith
  exact sub_eq_zero.1 (real_inner_self_nonpos.1 h4)
target_source: ∀ (F : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace ℝ F] [CompleteSpace F] (K : Set F) (u : F), K.Nonempty → IsClosed K → Convex ℝ K → ∃! v, v ∈ K ∧ ∀ w ∈ K, ‖u - v‖ ≤ ‖u - w‖
